title: Evidence Freshness & Expiration Intelligence
rationale: Auditors care about currency. Evidence that is 8 months old does not prove a control is working today. This module adds time-awareness to the existing Evidence system and tightly integrates with Findings (PRD-007).

user_stories.story: As a Compliance Manager, I want to set an expiration date or maximum age on evidence, so that I know when it becomes stale.
acceptance_criteria: Manager can set per-control evidence validity period (e.g., 90 days).
Evidence is flagged as 'Expired' when validity period passes.
Expired evidence triggers a Finding (PRD-007) automatically.

user_stories.story: As a Compliance Manager, I want the system to automatically request a refresh from the evidence owner before expiry, so that we maintain continuous compliance.
acceptance_criteria: System sends reminder at configurable intervals before expiry (30d, 14d, 7d).
Reminder includes link to re-upload evidence.
If not refreshed by expiry, the control's confidence score drops.

user_stories.story: As an Auditor, I want to see a 'confidence score' on each control based on evidence freshness, so that I can focus on areas of weakness.
acceptance_criteria: Each control shows a computed confidence score (High/Medium/Low).
Score factors in: evidence age, test results (PRD-008), and finding count (PRD-007).
Dashboard view highlights controls with Low confidence.

user_stories.story: As a Compliance Manager, I want a dashboard showing all controls with expired or soon-to-expire evidence, so that I can prioritize refresh efforts.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard lists controls sorted by evidence expiry date.
Visual indicators (Red/Yellow/Green) based on days until expiry.
One-click action to request evidence refresh from the owner.
